headline: GEL tumbles 25.00% on heavy volume, marking today’s sharpest move
market_take: Today's coverage shows heightened volatility across construction and property stocks, with GEL falling 25.00% on a 3.41x volume surge and AWC rallying 11.94% on 3.37x volume. Food names are under pressure, highlighted by AQUA’s 9.09% open gap and XBIO’s 11.11% gap, while consumer stocks show mixed signals – PLE down 22.22% versus SRICHA up 5.88%. REITs display modest gains, led by SSPF (+6.87%) and a volume spike in KTBSTMR. Notable 5‑day performers include TTCL (+33.3%) and MADAME (+27.4%).

AQUA experienced a -9.09% open gap and a +10.00% intraday swing; XBIO had an -11.11% open gap; MADAME posted a +9.72% intraday rise; F&D fell 6.12%.
PLE dropped 22.22% intraday; SOLAR fell 8.33% intraday; CNT slipped 6.19% intraday; SRICHA gained 5.88%; TTCL posted the strongest 5‑day gain (+33.3%) and filed a set clarification.
SSPF rose 6.87% intraday; M-PAT declined 6.47%; KTBSTMR showed a 3.6σ volume spike; QHBREIT filed a capital reduction; FUTURERT disclosed a related‑party transaction.
PPPM filed a board resolution on shareholding restructuring.
